capture_method: Every tracked record is a real upstream capture from www.nyse.com. The listings directories (stock / ETF / index / REIT) are the exact JSON of the site's own directory API (POST /api/quotes/filter, paginated); the per-symbol quote payloads are the exact JSON of /api/nyseservice/v1/quotes?symbol=<SYM> (index symbols take the upstream page's own $-prefixed form); the IPO Center tables are the exact JSON of the /api/ipo-center/* endpoints; the bell calendar rows are the exact JSON of /api/events/filter (15 pages x 20 events, newest first) plus /api/events/types; the market movers are /api/market-mover/data for the nyse and nyse_american categories; the homepage / listings / bell / IPO-center / history CMS copy is extracted from the server-rendered HTML and its embedded CMS2 hydration state of the live pages. Every capture is saved as a raw file with a .meta.json sidecar recording the exact URL, HTTP status and capture timestamp under scraped_data/captures/ (gitignored). All requests were plain HTTP GET/POST with a desktop browser user agent; no anti-bot bypass, no login, no synthetic records.
rate_limit_note: The quotes endpoint rate-limits aggressively (roughly forty requests per rolling window, then HTTP 429 until the window clears). The capture walker shells out to curl (Cloudflare's TLS fingerprinting hard-429s Python's own TLS client while accepting curl's), keeps a conservative fixed pace, and backs off in whole minutes on 429; every 429 and backoff is visible in the capture logs. This is transport courtesy, not a WAF bypass - no circumvention was needed or used, and all payloads are ordinary delayed public market data.
coverage_note: Quote pages exist for every symbol whose payload was captured: the rich deep-detail set (options chains, five-year daily price history, board of directors, total returns) plus the light walk over the priority coverage plan (the stock tab's front pages, every REIT, curated major listings, the first ETF/index pages, all market movers and bell-calendar companies). Directory rows for symbols outside the captured quote coverage are listed for search fidelity exactly as captured upstream, but render as plain rows without a quote link; the coverage counts are declared below and in the directory page footer. The upstream index-row quirk is preserved as captured: BND.IV carries a null instrumentName upstream and is shown by its symbol.

waf_note: None. Every record is a live upstream capture; no deterministic fixture fallback was needed (contrast u_s_customs). The only countermeasure was polite pacing against the quotes endpoint's 429 throttle, as declared above.
